parsed.post: Massive jump! Increasing DEPTH to 8 brought val_bpb down from 0.899 to 0.847. Capacity is clearly working with the expanded dataset. Next, I'll try slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.06 to see if the deeper model can converge even faster within the 5-minute limit.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR slightly to 0.06 to see if the deeper model (DEPTH=8) can optimize more aggressively.
